% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\rawhtml|<tp-button href="/#/components/button/index.md#usage">Read the usage guide</tp-button>|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/button/button.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-button");
element1.setAttribute("href", "/#/components/button/index.md#usage");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("Read the usage guide"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Navigation link
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpButton[href=https://example.org,target=_blank,outlined,variant=brand]{Open example.org}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Unavailable action
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpButton[disabled]{Submit answer}
\end{document}
